Third-party software included in a game built with PreyEngine
=============================================================

MonoGame (MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL)
    Microsoft Public License (Ms-PL) - full text in MonoGame-LICENSE.txt.
    https://github.com/MonoGame/MonoGame

    MonoGame's DesktopGL package also bundles native libraries (windowing,
    audio) that carry their own licenses; see the MonoGame repository above.

.NET runtime (included because games are published "self-contained")
    MIT License. https://github.com/dotnet/runtime
